notes: The BASIC text-to-image graph for the sd15 catalog entry (WORKPLAN 18 P5). Core nodes only -- CheckpointLoaderSimple / CLIPTextEncode x2 / EmptyLatentImage / KSampler / VAEDecode / SaveImage -- so it runs on the backend the panel installs with nothing added. Every input was confirmed against the RUNNING managed backend's /object_info on 2026-09-09 rather than from memory: KSampler and CheckpointLoaderSimple are not in scripts/comfy-node-defs.json, so the offline harvest could not have answered for them. The sampler/scheduler/steps/cfg values are the vendor's OWN default workflow (ComfyUI script_examples/basic_api_example.py: euler, normal, 20 steps, cfg 8, denoise 1) -- the point of a basic is that it is the shape ComfyUI itself ships, not a tuned one. The latent is 512x512, SD 1.5's training resolution; the panel overrides it when the user names a size.

prompt.note: reached by introspection anyway (the panel follows KSampler.positive/negative to the CLIPTextEncode pair, comfy-workflows/README.md); named here so a reader does not have to derive it. Note the NAMED input rather than a widget INDEX -- see whyNoResolution.

whyNoResolution: There is deliberately no procedural.resolution here, and the omission is load-bearing. procedural.resolution means 'this template derives its pixel dimensions from a MEGAPIXEL widget' (comfy.js injectProcedural), which is true of H3's ResolutionSelector and false of an EmptyLatentImage that takes literal width and height -- those are injected by introspection, which is what the README contract promises. Measured 2026-09-09: authoring it here anyway, in the positional form {nodeId: 4, widget: 0}, resolved widget 0 to the node's FIRST settable input, which is batch_size, and the panel wrote 0.15 megapixels into it. ComfyUI refused the whole graph before sampling a step: 'Prompt outputs failed validation [node 4 (EmptyLatentImage): Value 0 smaller than min of 1 -- batch_size]'. The positional widget form is the hazard; prefer a named input. See WORKPLAN 18 P5a.

models.note: one file carries unet + CLIP + VAE, which is why this graph needs no separate encoder or vae loader

panelIntegration.saveNode: SaveImage 7 -- filename_prefix is RELATIVE, so ComfyUI joins it onto its own output dir (an absolute prefix is refused by folder_paths.get_save_image_path and kills the render at its last node; see the KREA2 manifest's node 474)
